newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo gains on mark, boosted by EDP sale.
newsitem.headline: Escudo gains on mark, boosted by EDP sale.

text.p: The escudo firmed against the mark reflecting not just optimism about the single currency but also the success of Monday's partial privatisation of state utility company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, traders said.
The continued strength of the dollar and confidence that the European Union's single currency will be launched on time were pushing the mark down against a range of European currencies.

Traders said that the trend towards a firmer escudo could be maintained through the session. The currency was trading at 100.67/70 to the German currency against its close at 100.70/75 on Monday. They saw a 100.50-100.70 escudos range on Tuesday.
On Monday, the state sold off a 30 percent stake in EDP with foreign investors taking around a third of the shares on offer.
